registry.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: 1. At least 18 years of age at the time of signing the informed consent form (ICF) 2. At Screening and Randomization: AOBP SBP of ≥135 and ≤180 mmHg plus AOBP DBP of ≥65 and ≤110 mmHg, or AOBP DBP of ≥90 and ≤110 mmHg 3. Taking between 2 and 5 AHT medications, 4. History of hypertension lasting at least 6 months prior to Screening 5. Body mass index (BMI) of ≥18 kg/m2 at Screening Exclusion Criteria: 1. Women who are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breastfeeding 2. Participation in a study involving any investigational device or small-molecule drug within 4 weeks or 6 months for biologic (antibody) drugs prior to the Screening Visit 3. eGFR \<45 mL/min/1.73m2 at Screening, calculated using the Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) formula 4. Serum potassium \>5.0 mmol/L at Screening or \>4.8 mmol/L at Randomization 5. Serum sodium \<135 mmol/L (corrected for hyperglycemia) at Screening. 6. History of heart failure, myocardial infarction, stroke, or transient ischemic attack within 6 months prior to the Screening Visit.
